description.text: Premium Trainer Box, released on 9 December 2016 with the first Sun & Moon expansions: 20 booster packs, ten each of Collection Sun and Collection Moon, and 154 cards of 27 kinds for building decks, 40 Trainers, 6 Special Energy and 108 basic Energy, 12 of each of the nine types, XY and XY BREAK reprints among them. Premium extras came with it: acrylic damage counters like those of official tournaments, Poison and Burn markers and 64 sleeves found only in this box, a coin, a GX marker and a 650-card box in matte black with Solgaleo and Lunala in gloss. It followed the Master Deck Build Boxes, now with booster packs.
